name: Peninsula Gardens | Lantz
description: We were gifted this cut from Chocolate at Hytek. Bred by Ridgeline Farms, it’s a cross of Ridgeline Runtz and Green Lantern. Varies from bright green to deep purple. Think of it as a Runtz with a heavy kick of lime. Incredible smoker for the candy lovers.
